integrity: Proof supplies the exact backward solution, first two boundary-layer orders and full exponential moment limit. Deterministic numerical checking is supplemental; scientific priority requires independent scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a single, axisymmetric, field-aligned rotational diffusion on the sphere and a cap with fixed positive joint-scaling parameter. No translational-target first-passage conclusion or uniform cap-parameter limit is claimed. Earlier magnetic-moment first-passage and general narrow-escape literature was not all fully accessible.
title: Antipodal-cap boundary layer and exponential reversal law for a magnetically aligned active Brownian swimmer
